# Hello
My name is James Thompson. I am a 20ish old living in New Zealand. I am a AI researcher who works on problems in AI safety and AI applications. 

# Currently (November 2026)
Living in New Zealand. Finished my [Master's of AI](posts/261127-changing-llm-behaviour-with-survey-question/) recently and working on entering the AI safety space (likely in alignment, behavioural evaluations, or raising awareness).

Always keen to hear about opportunities to work on making the world a better place. I am surprisingly open to a wide range of ideas, stemming from my own uncertainty.
